title: Browser sign-in
summary: Authorize a declared identity locally or on a registered Test Machine from a connected workstation with --test-machine. A Linux or Windows WSL RDP route opens the desktop-access viewer; the operator signs in with the identity's declared account and the viewer closes after verification. A macOS VNC route opens Screen Sharing from a Mac workstation, with the desktop password on a clipboard that clears after 60 seconds. Without a viewer route or client, the command prints the desktop-access command and recovery. Unrouted hosts can receive nonsecret declarations locally. An explicit --url always opens its authorization window even when every declared site probes signed in, including native desktop and Test Machine routes. Without --url, a fully signed-in identity still skips the window.
